---
title: "Mera Sar Iss Liye Oncha Bohat Hai Hasnain Mehdi"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Manqabat"
poet: "Asad"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Mera Sar Iss Liye Oncha Bohat Hai Hasnain Mehdi.
Dar-e-Abbas Par Jhukta Bohat Hai.
Kissi Ne Haal Pocha Tu Main Bola.
Karam Abbas Ki Maa Ka Bohat Hai.

2
Ali Baab Ul Hawaij Keh Ke Bolay.
Laqab Ghazi Pe Yeh Jachta Bohat Hai.
Banaye Dosra Yousuf Khuda Tu.
Paseeney Ka Tere Qatra Bohat Hai.

3
Abhi Abbas Ki Hai Jang Baqi.
Abhi Shabeer Ka Badlah Bohat Hai.
Galay Mein Shar Ke Pahnda Dalne Ko.
Jarri Ki Mashk Ka Tasma Bohat Hai.

4
Kabhi Abbas Se Keh Kar Tu Dekho.
Khuda Abbas Ki Sunta Bohat Hai.
Samajhne Ke Liye Kabay Ki Azmat.
 Asad Abbas Ka Roza Bohat Hai

from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/mera-sar-iss-liye-oncha-bohat-hai-hasnain-mehdi-tajpoints-238b6893e7306eb65dcc.md')
_, metadata, body = p.read_text().split('---\\n')
roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
for edition, numerals in [(roman, '1234'), (body, '۱۲۳۴')]:
    blocks = edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(blocks) == 4
    for block, numeral in zip(blocks, numerals):
        lines = [line.strip() for line in block.splitlines()]
        assert lines[0] == numeral and len(lines) == 5
assert all(not line or line.startswith('  ') for line in roman.splitlines())
print('Verified four aligned stanzas with four verses each.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 16 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both editions align across four stanzas. Added the Urdu title, retained the Roman alternate title, set right-to-left direction, and removed the resolved `noUrdu` tag.

In stanza 3, I read “Pahnda” as پھندا and “Jarri” as جری.
